violations.text: Raw animal foods (such as eggs and beef) were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods (such as produce and black beans) in the refrigerator units. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. PIC relocated raw items. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/29/2026

Working containers used for storing chemicals taken from bulk supplies were not marked with the common name of the chemical. PIC labeled during inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/29/2026

The establishment is lacking a thermometer to test food temperatures. Food temperature measuring devices shall be provided and be readily accessible for checking cooking, cooling, reheating, and hot/cold holding temperatures of time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. New Violation. Correct By: 09/29/2026
Inspector observed container of ice cubes in deep freezer chest uncovered. PIC informed to cover container to prevent possible contamination. New Violation. Correct By: 09/29/2026
The non-food contact surfaces of the deep freezer chest have an accumulation of ice, food residue, and other debris. New Violation. Correct By: 09/29/2026
